title: Create a coherent operational backup
description: Capture selected retained operational scope without changing the source.
inputs: Current operational records and required retained artifacts
preconditions: The requested scope and applicable action authority are explicit.
outputs: Identifiable complete backup or explicit incomplete/failed result
behavior: For a selected project state containing Changes, findings and retained artifacts, a complete backup identifies the captured state, project, interpretation version, included records and artifacts, and declared exclusions; all included references resolve within the retained scope or are explicitly external.

When recording continues during capture, the backup represents one coherent declared state or reports that capture could not complete; it never combines incompatible record and artifact versions as a complete backup.
If a required artifact is missing, unreadable or fails its recorded integrity check, backup creation reports the affected scope and does not declare a complete backup.
Interruption, cancellation or insufficient destination capacity leaves existing valid backups and source work unchanged and identifies any incomplete output as unusable for complete restoration.
An explicitly selected narrower scope identifies exclusions and cannot claim to preserve excluded evidence, post-capture work or unsaved content.

failure_behavior.condition: Required source, interpretation or scope integrity cannot be established.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report the specific gap without claiming completeness, inventing decisions or mutating unrelated work.

failure_behavior.condition: Selected source or destination changes before a mutating operation can complete.
failure_behavior.outcome: Preserve established work and report conflict or interruption; no silent overwrite or automatic semantic merge.

unallocated_reason: The local operational-history extension is draft system analysis. Module/Interface and AR allocation are deferred to Architecture Allocation; existing v3 facets do not establish realization of this behavior.

sources.basis: Draft derivation from the refined IRs and RR proposal; no approval, implementation or satisfaction claim.
